name: Site footer

variant.note: 'home' leaves .footer_links-container empty (a 0-height spacer); 'site' renders three ul.footer_link-list columns.

linkColumns.note: Fixed: column 1 Parents/Sitters/Trust & Safety, column 2 FAQ/Careers/Blog/Contact, column 3 the four social links (all target=_blank). Chrome, not page content.

constraints.fixedCopy: The left card's heading, body, CTA label, the terms/privacy links and the copyright line are identical on every marketing route. A PageSpec cannot override them.
constraints.leadingEmptyContainer: The footer renders an extra EMPTY, zero-height div.container immediately before div.container.cc-footer-container, matching the original's DOM. It is structural noise with no content contract and no settable fields, but it is part of the faithful markup — do not remove it as cleanup.

motion.note: No entrance or scroll animation. CSS hover transitions on .btn (colour trio, 300ms ease.outQuart) are global chrome behaviour, not section motion.

responsive.desktop: two cards side by side inside .container.cc-footer-container (flex-wrap, space-between, gap 40px). Left card min-width 20rem, right min-width 66.66%.
responsive.le991: left card min-width 100% -> the two cards wrap to two full-width rows.
responsive.le767: .footer_row becomes a column with 32px gap and the wordmark gets order:-1, sitting above the terms row. Link rows tighten to 12px gap.
responsive.le479: left card padding drops to 1.5em; each link list becomes 50% wide.

notes: Two clip-path blobs: footer-shape-left filled olive on the dark card, footer-shape-right filled peach on the white card.
